mapper.sql: select c.course_id, c.category_id, c.teacher_id, c.course_name, c.course_subtitle, c.cover_image, c.intro, c.detail_html, c.tags, c.difficulty_level, c.publish_status, c.recommend_flag, c.hot_flag, c.banner_flag, c.allow_register, c.sort_order, c.view_count, c.like_count, c.enroll_count, c.content_count, c.exam_count, c.last_content_time, c.publish_time, c.status, c.del_flag, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark, cat.category_name, u.nick_name as teacher_name from edu_course c left join edu_course_category cat on c.category_id = cat.category_id left join sys_user u on c.teacher_id = u.user_id

choose.otherwise: order by c.sort_order desc, c.publish_time desc, c.course_id desc

mapper.select: where c.course_id = #{courseId} and c.del_flag = '0' and c.status = '0' and c.publish_status = '1'
where c.del_flag = '0' and c.status = '0' and c.publish_status = '1' and c.recommend_flag = '1' order by c.sort_order desc, c.update_time desc, c.course_id desc limit #{limitNum}
where c.del_flag = '0' and c.status = '0' and c.publish_status = '1' order by c.hot_flag desc, c.enroll_count desc, c.like_count desc, c.view_count desc, c.course_id desc limit #{limitNum}
where c.del_flag = '0' and c.status = '0' and c.publish_status = '1' order by ifnull(c.last_content_time, c.publish_time) desc, c.course_id desc limit #{limitNum}
mapper.update:
update edu_course set del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where course_id in
#{courseId}

update edu_course c set c.content_count = ( select count(1) from edu_course_content cc where cc.course_id = c.course_id ), c.last_content_time = ( select max(coalesce(cc.update_time, cc.create_time)) from edu_course_content cc where cc.course_id = c.course_id ), c.update_time = sysdate() where c.course_id = #{courseId}

update edu_course c set c.enroll_count = ( select count(1) from edu_course_enroll ce where ce.course_id = c.course_id and ce.enroll_status = '1' ), c.update_time = sysdate() where c.course_id = #{courseId}
update edu_course c set c.like_count = ( select count(1) from edu_course_like cl where cl.course_id = c.course_id ), c.update_time = sysdate() where c.course_id = #{courseId}

update edu_course_banner set course_id = null, update_time = sysdate() where course_id in
#{courseId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from edu_course where teacher_id = #{teacherId} and del_flag = '0'
